summary: Type-Moon's Tsukihime is a visual novel lineage split between the complete 2000 doujin original and the modern remake project, whose first part covers only the Near-side routes.

entries.title: Tsukihime
entries.definitive_edition: Original 2000 PC for full historical scope; A Piece of Blue Glass Moon for current official localized access

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PC release or current official remake with route scope documented

primary.version: Original 2000 PC for full original scope; A Piece of Blue Glass Moon for current official access
primary.why: The original 2000 doujin PC game is the complete historical Tsukihime, while Tsukihime: A Piece of Blue Glass Moon is the modern official localized route but covers the Near-side remake portion only. Archive runs must label whether they target original full scope or modern remake accessibility.
primary.how_to_play: For the original, use a legally preserved PC copy and record route, patch/language state, adult-content state, and ending. For current official access, use A Piece of Blue Glass Moon on Switch/PS4/Steam and record platform, language, voice, route, CG/music state, and that Far-side remake content is separate/pending.

secondary.platform: Tsukihime: A Piece of Blue Glass Moon
secondary.exclusive_content: Modern voiced/remade Near-side routes with official localization
secondary.what_to_play: Use as the practical current official route.
secondary.why: It is not identical to the complete 2000 original.

all_releases.fidelity: Complete historical adult visual novel route.
all_releases.reason: primary: target artifact for the 2000 title.

all_releases.platform: Tsukihime: A Piece of Blue Glass Moon
all_releases.fidelity: Current official localized remake route for Near-side content.
all_releases.reason: primary: best current official access route, but incomplete versus original full route set.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The original is complete but hard to access officially; the remake is current/localized but not identical or full-scope.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record original/remake branch, route coverage, language, and adult/all-ages content state.
